name: Yellow Sapphire
summary: Untreated Ceylon yellow sapphires of radiant clarity, revered for warm golden fire and traditional auspiciousness.
quote: Don't only ask how many carats. Ask whether it is natural, whether it has been treated, and whether independent certification is available.

keyAttributes.label: Preferred Metal
keyAttributes.value: 22K Fine Yellow Gold or Handcrafted Panchdhatu

keyAttributes.label: Certification
keyAttributes.value: Independent Lab Certification (IIGJ / Reputed Testing Lab)

deepDive: Natural Yellow Sapphire (Pukhraj) is one of the most revered astrological gemstones. At Gulshan Jewellers, our focus is uncompromising: we prioritize unheated Ceylon stones with natural honey-lemon hues. We handcraft bespoke 22K gold settings designed so the stone's pavilion breathes freely, honoring both traditional alignment and timeless contemporary elegance.
evaluationChecklist: Natural vs Lab-Grown: Request proof that the sapphire crystallized naturally in the earth, not in a flux or hydrothermal laboratory.
Thermal Treatment: Verify that the stone has not undergone high-temperature heating, beryllium diffusion, or glass filling.
Hue & Saturation: Look for vivid canary or golden lemon tones without dull greenish or brownish undertones.
Eye-Clean Clarity: Natural fine silk inclusions verify earth-origin while preserving crystalline transparency.
Independent Lab Report: Always demand an accredited gemological certificate detailing treatment status and origin.

faq.q: Why is Ceylon (Sri Lanka) Yellow Sapphire so sought-after?
faq.a: Ceylon deposits yield sapphires with superior natural lustre, vibrant canary-yellow saturation, and exceptional clarity without the artificial heating common in other origins.

faq.q: What setting is recommended for Pukhraj?
faq.a: Traditionally, 22K yellow gold or bespoke Panchdhatu is preferred, crafted with an open-back basket so the gemstone rests comfortably with maximum light entry.

name: Blue Sapphire
summary: Deep velvety royal blue natural corundum with mesmerizing depth, mounted in platinum or 18K white gold.
quote: A little blue, a lot of brilliance. Neelam demands patience, disciplined evaluation, and absolute transparency.

keyAttributes.label: Origin
keyAttributes.value: Ceylon / Kashmir / Madagascar (Origin disclosed only when certified)

keyAttributes.label: Preferred Metal
keyAttributes.value: 18K White Gold, Platinum, or Sterling Silver

deepDive: Neelam is among the most intensely scrutinized gems in the world. Its deep velvety blue spectrum ranges from cornflower to royal midnight. Because astrological recommendations for Saturn are deeply personal, our consultations are structured around stone quality, cut precision, and personal comfort before any setting is forged.
evaluationChecklist: Color Uniformity: Ensure the blue is distributed without harsh colour zoning or dark extinction patches.
No Glass-Filling: Reject stones with lead-glass or resin fillings that falsely mask fissures.
Inclusion Architecture: Look for fine rutile needles (silk) indicating natural crystallization.
Personal Trial: In traditional guidance, wearing or inspecting the stone closely during private consultation ensures comfort.
Accredited Documentation: Full certificate stating corundum species and unheated verification.

faq.q: What if an authentic Blue Sapphire exceeds my current budget?
faq.a: We transparently present Blue Kyanite in 925 sterling silver as a considered, honest natural alternative that captures the astrological resonance without financial strain.

name: Emerald
summary: Luminous green beryl with natural jardin inclusions, celebrating life, intellect, and timeless green radiance.
quote: In emeralds, inclusions are not flaws—they are the stone's fingerprint, its natural jardin.

keyAttributes.label: Treatment
keyAttributes.value: Traditional Cedarwood Oil only (Resin/Polymer fully disclosed or avoided)

keyAttributes.label: Certification
keyAttributes.value: Laboratory Certificate with Clarity Enhancement Disclosure

deepDive: The natural emerald's distinctive 'jardin' (garden of microscopic liquid and mineral inclusions) proves it was born within the earth's crust. At Gulshan Jewellers, we celebrate natural emeralds with vivid green saturation, setting them in minimalist bezel collars that protect their delicate corners while maximizing luminous presence.
evaluationChecklist: Clarity Enhancement: Natural cedarwood oil is the age-old accepted standard; ensure resin, dyed oils, or polymers are never hidden.
Vibrancy over Darkness: An emerald should glow from within; overly dark stones lack the essential life of Budha.
Secure Architectural Settings: Emeralds require thoughtful setting choices—bezel or protective corner prongs.
Origin Documentation: Colombian and Zambian stones exhibit distinct crystal architectures.

faq.a: Yes, when mounted in a protective bezel pendant or low-profile ring, natural emeralds age gracefully through decades of wear.

name: Natural Ruby
summary: Fiery crimson red corundum embodying vitality, regal legacy, and the radiant energy of Surya.
quote: A true natural ruby does not shout; it pulses with internal crimson fire.

keyAttributes.label: Treatment
keyAttributes.value: Unheated or Minimal Traditional Heat Disclosed

deepDive: Known in Sanskrit as 'Ratnaraj' (King of Gems), natural ruby holds a preeminent place in Indian fine jewellery. We curate untreated and minimally heated natural rubies with vivid crimson saturation, ensuring every stone possesses the warmth and dignity fitting for an heirloom piece.
evaluationChecklist: Natural Fluorescence: Genuine rubies display an unmistakable red glow under natural sunlight.
Disclosure of Lead-Glass: Beware of heavily fractured glass-filled composites in the commercial market; we strictly offer natural earth-mined rubies.
Cut Proportions: Look for symmetrical facets that return crimson light rather than windowed grey centers.

faq.q: How does Mozambique ruby compare to Burmese ruby?
faq.a: Mozambique rubies have emerged as a premier source offering exceptional transparency and rich crimson color at significantly higher value than scarce historic Burmese specimens.

name: Blue Kyanite
summary: Natural pleochroic blue gemstone set in 925 sterling silver—making authentic astrological resonance accessible at every budget.
quote: Intention and authenticity matter far more than prohibitive price. We craft thoughtful alternatives with equal reverence.
deepDive: At Gulshan Jewellers, we believe fine jewellery and astrological alignment should never feel exclusive or exclusionary. When an unheated Ceylon Blue Sapphire is beyond a client's current budget, Blue Kyanite set in 925 sterling silver offers an honest, earth-mined alternative. With its striking fibrous blue depth and untreated purity, it represents our brand promise: transparent guidance tailored to your life.
evaluationChecklist: Fibrous Pleochroism: Natural kyanite displays blue tone variations depending on the angle of observation.
Untreated Integrity: Kyanite is virtually never treated, ensuring raw natural earth energy.
Silver Craftsmanship: A solid 925 silver bezel provides both aesthetic heritage and everyday durability.

faq.q: Is Kyanite astrologically acceptable as an alternative to Neelam?
faq.a: Yes. In traditional Indian gemology (Up-ratna), Kyanite and Iolite are respected natural substitutes for Shani when chosen with clear intention and natural untreated quality.
